title: Month 2's orders
headline: Morten goes next door to delve floor 2 under the Humans' A5; the tower saves its 67 GP.
prose: Floor 2 is the safe step toward level 4: a level-2 floor one day away, under an ally's hex. Floor 3 lies past the Gnomes' B4, an L10 hex with level-10 wanderers, so it waits.

bullets.label: Travel
bullets.text: B5 → A5, 1 day, a d6 for wanderers on arrival (1 = an encounter).

bullets.label: The tower
bullets.text: no action. 67 GP buys nothing; everything costs 200 GP or more.
